article.headline: Doumbia's 16 help Wright State defeat Oakland 66-62
article.description: — Jack Doumbia's 16 points helped Wright State defeat Oakland 66-62 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Doumbia's 16 help Wright State defeat Oakland 66-62

categories.description: Oakland Golden Grizzlies @ Wright State Raiders

event.description: Oakland Golden Grizzlies @ Wright State Raiders

keywords: Oakland Golden Grizzlies @ Wright State Raiders
article.story: FAIRBORN, Ohio -- — Jack Doumbia's 16 points helped Wright State defeat Oakland 66-62 on Thursday night. Doumbia also added six rebounds for the Raiders (9-8, 3-3 Horizon League). Keaton Norris shot 4 for 8, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc to add 14 points. Andrea Holden shot 5 of 8 from the field and 1 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding 11 rebounds. Tuburu Niavalurua led the way for the Golden Grizzlies (5-12, 2-4) with 16 points, eight rebounds and two steals. Allen David Mukeba Jr. added 13 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for Oakland. Isaiah Jones had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
